plan.execution_state: preregistered; actual model contrasts not executed
plan.question: Under explicit nominal response and noise assumptions, which four new UV observing bundles most strongly distinguish the frozen ordinary/+1dex thermal-balance model families after normalization and existing attenuation nuisances?
competing_predictions: Increasing N/C at fixed environment changes both line strengths and thermal balance, rather than multiplying nitrogen flux by10
Density, ionization, ionizing spectrum and metallicity can imitate composition-driven UV changes
Intrinsic broadening and free attenuation can reduce line-shape/color information
plan.expected_information_gain: Identify concrete missing line/component observables; determine whether the finite ordinary/enhanced families remain degenerate after new measurements. No elemental abundance inference, posterior model weights or stellar-yield ranking.
plan.input_gate: Merged independently validated complete Cloudy C23.01 pilot: all20 declared models, converged/reviewed line identities, actual abundances, separate intrinsic/emergent29line responses, thermal balance percomposition; exact artifact/source hashes frozen before calculation
plan.model_family: Ten declared environmental rows, each independently rerun at logNC=-0.60 and+0.40. No new physical models.
plan.primary_prediction_contract: Upstream native comparison line contract retained; emergent/intrinsic separated alternatives where available, never pooled. CIV escape/stellar transfer remains unresolved.
plan.response: Pinned primary G235H and G235M curves; source-specific LSF unmeasured, aperture-specific detector gaps unresolved. White constant variance perunit observed wavelength for each separate mode; mode-dependent noise normalization remains unavailable.
plan.attenuation_law: Reuse exact upstream Cloudy pilot law; no added attenuation scenarios
plan.distance: Continuous Gaussian-line Gram distance with nonnegative amplitude profiled for each alternative. Expected squared separation target9. Truth matched-template SNR defined for each bundle and mode separately.
plan.comparisons: Matched-environment ordinary/+1dex pairs plus closest crossenvironment/attenuation pair in frozen families; deterministic finite-model sensitivity, never independent trials or probabilities
plan.extra_stage_design: NV1239/1243 and Cloudy-air CII2323-2328 sums relative to CIII reported as modelpredicted range/overlap only. Air/vacuum convention explicit. Optical lines remain outofNIRSpec and require newresponse/ETC.
plan.stopping_rule: Stop after4bundles finite-family shapecontrasts and stage ranges. If data are incomplete/nonconverged/unmerged stopdependentcalculation. Do not refinephysicalgrid or giveexposurefeasibility without source-specific calibration/ETC.
plan.validation: Separate reviewer independently quadratures selected spectralshapes, minimizes amplitude, verifies exactline mapping/modelidentity/attenuation and absenceofpooledlikelihoods. Author tests not solevalidation.
